p: thirty years old and upward even: The Levites were counted at three times, first at a month old when they were consecrated to the Lord, next at 25 years old when they were appointed to serve in the tabernacle, and 30 years old to bear the burdens of the tabernacle.
covering vail: Which divided the sanctuary from the holiest of holies.
the staves thereof: That is, put them on their shoulders to carry it: for the bars of the ark could never be removed.
withal: Meaning, to cover the bread.
bar: The Hebrew word signifies an instrument made of two staves or bars.
altar they shall spread a cloth: Which was to burn incense, read Ex 30:1.
altar: Of the burnt offering.
sanctuary: That is, in folding up the things of the sanctuary, as the ark, etc.
touch any holy thing: Before it is covered.
daily meat offering: Which was offered at morning and evening.
Cut ye not off the tribe: Committing by your negligence that the holy things are not well wrapped, causing them to perish by touching it.
them every one to his service: Showing what part every man shall bear.
enter in to perform the service: Which were received into the company of those who ministered in the tabernacle of the congregation.
door of the tabernacle of the: Which hung between the sanctuary and the court.
which is by the tabernacle and: Which compassed both the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar of burnt offering.
hand of Ithamar the son of: Under the charge and oversight.
name ye shall reckon the instruments: You shall take inventory of all the things, which you commit to their charge.
hand of Moses: God appointing Moses to be the minister and executor of it.
might do service in the tabernacle: Which were of eligible age to serve in it, that is between 30 and 50.
the service of the ministry: Whoever of the Levites that had any charge in the tabernacle.
Moses: So that Moses neither added, nor diminished from that which the Lord commanded him.
